//: Firebase Hosting only serves static files; Giant Money is a running Node server (SQLite + a 24/7 cron loop). So Hosting serves the CDN-friendly assets and rewrites every page and API request to the container on Cloud Run. See DEPLOY.md.

hosting.//ignore: The .html files are deliberately NOT deployed. Firebase serves static files BEFORE applying rewrites, so a deployed public/index.html would hijack '/' and show the old /classic landing instead of the real one. Leaving the HTML out lets every page fall through to Cloud Run, which already routes them correctly.

headers.//: app.js and styles.css change on every deploy, so never let a browser hold a stale copy.
